request.query: membership in a finite Cartesian product of intervals iff coordinatewise bounds

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "BoxIntegral.Box.mem_mk",
      "informal_name": "Membership in Boxes via Left-Open Right-Closed Intervals",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {ι : Type u_1} {l u x : ι → ℝ} {H : ∀ (i : ι), l i < u i},\n  x ∈ { lower := l, upper := u, lower_lt_upper := H } ↔ ∀ (i : ι), x i ∈ Set.Ioc (l i) (u i)",
      "informal_description": "For a box $ B $ constructed from lower bounds $ l $ and upper bounds $ u $ in $ \\iota $-dimensional space, a point $ x $ is in $ B $ if and only if for every coordinate $ i $, the $ i $-th component of $ x $ lies in the left-open right-closed interval $ (l(i), u(i)] $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.BoxIntegral.Box.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "BoxIntegral.Box.mem_def",
      "informal_name": "Membership in Boxes via Left-Open Right-Closed Intervals",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {ι : Type u_1} (I : BoxIntegral.Box ι) {x : ι → ℝ}, x ∈ I ↔ ∀ (i : ι), x i ∈ Set.Ioc (I.lower i) (I.upper i)",
      "informal_description": "A point $ x $ belongs to the box $ I $ if and only if for every coordinate $ i $, the $ i $-th component of $ x $ lies in the left-open right-closed interval $ (I.\\text{lower}(i), I.\\text{upper}(i)] $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.BoxIntegral.Box.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "BoxIntegral.Box.instMembershipForallReal",
      "informal_name": "Membership in Boxes via Left-Open Right-Closed Intervals",
      "kind": "instance",
      "type": "{ι : Type u_1} → Membership (ι → ℝ) (BoxIntegral.Box ι)",
      "informal_description": "For any box $ B $ in $ n $-dimensional space and a point $ x $, $ x $ is in $ B $ if and only if for every coordinate $ i $, the $ i $-th component of $ x $ lies in the left-open right-closed interval $ (B.\text{lower}(i), B.\text{upper}(i)] $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.BoxIntegral.Box.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "BoxIntegral.Box.mem_univ_Ioc",
      "informal_name": "Equivalence of Box Membership and Product of Left-Open Right-Closed Intervals",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {ι : Type u_1} {x : ι → ℝ} {I : BoxIntegral.Box ι}, (x ∈ Set.univ.pi fun i => Set.Ioc (I.lower i) (I.upper i)) ↔ x ∈ I",
      "informal_description": "For any box $ I $ in $ n $-dimensional space and a point $ x $, $ x $ belongs to the Cartesian product of the left-open right-closed intervals $ (I.\\text{lower}(i), I.\\text{upper}(i)] $ over all coordinates $ i $ if and only if $ x $ is an element of $ I $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.BoxIntegral.Box.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Set.pi_univ_Ioc_subset",
      "informal_name": "Cartesian Product of Left-Open Right-Closed Intervals is Subset of Corresponding Interval in Product Space",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → Preorder (α i)] (x y : (i : ι) → α i) [Nonempty ι],\n  (Set.univ.pi fun i => Set.Ioc (x i) (y i)) ⊆ Set.Ioc x y",
      "informal_description": "For a non-empty index set $\\iota$, the Cartesian product of the left-open right-closed intervals $(x_i, y_i]$ over all $i \\in \\iota$ is a subset of the left-open right-closed interval $(x, y]$ in the product space $\\prod_{i \\in \\iota} \\alpha_i$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.Pi"
    }
  ]
}
